text: Run R package root: NAMESPACE man/ generated roxygen, don’t edit hand. Edit README.Rmd, README.md. Code formatted Air (air.toml: 80-character lines, 2-space indent, <- assignment). Run air format .. RELEASE.R release checklist. DEVTESTS.R holds scratch code manual exploration. Tests: run devtools::test(), run one file devtools::test(filter = "format"). title: Code Design
text: core package doesn’t depend Shiny. Data flows steps: fetch_renmods() (R/fetch.R) connects renmods::renmods_connect(), filters Location_ID (EMS IDs, always converted character) date range, loads result memory. returns raw EnMoDS columns, TitleCase names. output long format: one row per location, date parameter. Derived values added extra rows. include meq values (result_unit == "meq/l"), charge balance anion/cation sums. fmt_wide() pivots output fmt_minimal() wide format. pivoting, resolves repeated multi-method measurements fix_multiple_measures() (R/fix.R). meq(), charge_balance() water_type() R/calculations.R. Comparison water quality guidelines R/water_quality.R. stiff_plot() R/plots.R. reactable tables R/tables.R. check_samples() (R/checks.R) validates inputs. receives raw output fetch_renmods(), applies fmt_minimal() automatically.

title: Code Design
text: CSV lookup tables inst/extdata/ control parameters columns named. read runtime read_data() (R/utils-data.R) exposed index_params(), index_meta(), index_meta_params(), ion_details() wq_std(). index_params() maps EnMoDS parameter names (enmods_param) snake_case bcgwcat_param names. code uses bcgwcat_param names throughout. index_meta() index_meta_params() map column names EnMoDS bcgwcat. meta_vars(, param_vars) returns set columns "bcgwcat" "enmods". columns also keys identify single observation. EnMoDS reports charge balance ion sums. parameters get _enmods suffix, don’t clash charge_balance, anion_sum cation_sum package calculates. CSVs generated files. data-raw/parameters.R builds : hand-edited CSVs data-raw/ ion_details table, defined inside script drinking water guidelines (wq_std), downloaded bcdata change table, edit source data-raw/ re-run script. Don’t edit inst/extdata/ directly. script also writes internal objects ems_ids_all min_date R/sysdata.rda.

title: Code Design
text: bcgwcat_app() (R/app.R) builds bslib::page_navbar modules R/mod_*.R. module mod_<name>_ui() mod_<name>_server() function. Overview: mod_overview_server() handles status downloads renmods cache. returns updated, reactiveVal counter goes time local data changes. Data: mod_data_server(updated, ...) takes counter handles choosing EMS IDs dates fetching data. Water quality plots: data module returns sample data mod_water_quality_server() mod_plots_server() use. Messages: package’s inform() abort() (cli wrappers R/messages.R) shown -app console with_messages() (R/utils-shiny.R). Theme: theme comes inst/shiny-assets/_brand.yml, BC Sans fonts bundled. Prompts: bcgwcat_ui() sets rlang_interactive = FALSE, renmods doesn’t stop ask questions terminal.
